sinopsis.es: Condenado a pagar las cotizaciones a la seguridad social que debía su hijo, un padre (Kamel El Basha) intenta desesperadamente demostrar su muerte, en el conmovedor drama Conversation With The Sea.
sinopsis.en: Condemned to pay the social security contributions owed by his son, a father (Kamel El Basha) desperately tries to prove his death in the moving drama Conversation With The Sea.
